entries.en: At least it's a dry heat.
Hell of a place.
Like an oven here.
I think my eyeballs are dried out.
Remember to stay hydrated.
I thought Palaven was hot.
Nothing but rocks, dirt, and lava. Reminds me of home.
Fifty degrees hotter and I might start to feel uncomfortable. How are you mammals doing, Shepard?
My people have searched many generations for a world to call home. If we landed here, we'd just keep searching.
Even the geth wouldn't want to live in this heat.
Commander, I'm picking up some strange readings. Really strange. Like, off the damn charts.
It looks like it's coming from an underground complex a few klicks away from the drop zone.
Only a fool punches a nathak in the mouth. We should sneak around and pull its tail.
This route's a no-go. They have height and cover.
The Chief's right. In this terrain, we might be able to sneak into their flank.
I don't think we can take that strongpoint head-on.
The L-T's right. We should bypass, see if we can take them in flank.
Trying to knock down the front door seems stupid. Maybe we could find a side window?
The focusing lenses are still intact. I bet we can get this working again.
Looks like this could be reactivated. It was probably too expensive to pull out.
This would make a hell of a weapon. Anything that can vaporize rock could maul an armored column.
You hear that hum? I think the power plant is still active.
Think this would work if I kicked it?
I-- I still cannot believe all this. Why would the geth come after me? Do you think Benezia's involved?
Saren's looking for the Conduit. You're a Prothean expert. He probably wants you to help him find it.
Saren's looking for the Conduit. Think fast, Ms. Prothean Expert.
Saren's looking for the Conduit. You're a Prothean expert. Obviously he wants you to help him find it.
The Conduit? But I don't know--
What the hell was that?
What the hell was that?
These ruins aren't stable. That mining laser must have triggered a seismic event.
Joker! Get the Normandy airborne and lock in on my signal. On the double, mister!
We need an escape plan.
We have to hurry. The whole place is caving in!
Aye, aye, Commander. Secure and aweigh. ETA eight minutes.
He needs to move faster.
Gonna be close, skipper.
If I die in here, I'll kill him.
Not much margin for error.
We're getting out of here!
It looks like this cavern formed around the ruin. After it was built.
I've never visited a Prothean ruin before. Aside from the Citadel, I mean.
Dare you to spit over the side.
Long way down.
Lot of dark corners in here.
Sterile white. Protheans sure build things homey.
The tiles in those holes remind me of a bathroom floor.
Protheans built to last. Looks like a lava flow poured in here.
I wonder what Liara's looking for in here. Most Prothean ruins have nothing more than dead instrumentation.
This is fascinating. It is not like the Citadel's architecture at all.
Now I am hallucinating that you are inside the tower. I must be getting worse. Earlier, I even imagined I heard thunder.
Yes, you're right. I've seen enough of them to last a lifetime. That button should shut down my containment field.
I am sorry, but I am in no mood to keep talking to a hallucination.
Of course. What good is a hallucination if it doesn't give false hope?
I am still trapped. And hungry. Please. Could we talk after you release me?
It's not like I'm going anywhere, but could you please hurry?
Are you-- Are you real? Oh no, don't be stupid, Liara. Humans do not come here. You're hallucinating.
You're oddly lucid for a hallucination. They don't usually claim to be real.
A Spectre? Ha. That's good. What else would I conjure up? A protector figure. Yes, perfect. Comforting.
Can you hear me out there? I am trapped. I need help!
